name: @kisev/skills-opencode
description: OpenCode integration and opt-in installer for portable Agent Skills.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/generate-assets.js
scripts.format: prettier --config ../../.prettierrc.json --ignore-path ../../.prettierignore --write src test package.json tsconfig.json README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --config ../../.prettierrc.json --ignore-path ../../.prettierignore --check src test package.json tsconfig.json README.md
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/agent-profiles.test.mjs && node --test test/doctor.test.mjs && node --test test/package.test.mjs && node --test test/stage19.test.mjs
